rationale.conceptual: The method (B3LYP/LANL2DZ with TDDFT) is established but non-trivial; it requires careful setup for open-shell systems, construction of metal-organic geometries, and correct population analysis. Domain expertise in computational chemistry is needed to avoid mistakes, but no novel algorithms are implemented.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves building geometries, running ~6 geometry optimizations and 3 TDDFT calculations, managing input/output files for an external tool (ORCA), and packaging results. This multi-stage workflow with dependency handling and tool orchestration is moderately complex.
